selected_evidence.requirement: Synchronize the system clock with pool.ntp.org
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration shows pool.ntp.org; Chrony selected a live source with NTP synchronized=yes and leap status Normal.

The restart was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 9ed9e820-6949-4971-a6a0-9fda0c2ea7ee to 6dbd8422-f576-4a86-9ec4-00076c133750, and post-restart evidence shows Chrony active, enabled, configured for pool.ntp.org, and synchronized.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and fully recovered time-service state.
